notes: dims_m is [width x, height y, depth z] in metres, Unity order. Poly Haven's info 'dimensions' are [X, Y, Z] in mm in Blender's Z-up frame (width, depth, height); converted to metres and reordered to [X, Z, Y]. They are the bounding box of the whole asset as published; check the imported scale against them (Poly Haven FBX come from Blender; if a model imports 100x off, fix the importer scale, not the numbers).

Model textures keep the relative layout from Poly Haven's FBX 'include' map (textures/<name>_1k.<ext>). Most models' normal and metallic maps are EXR and some maps are PNG: set normal maps to the Normal Map texture type in Unity. 'materials' groups each model's maps by the material key in the file name ('_' = the model's single material); map keys: diff, nor_gl, roughness, metallic, ao, arm, alpha, disp.
Surface size_m is the real-world width one texture tile covers (Poly Haven info dimensions; ambientCG dimensionX in cm).
Surface normal maps are the OpenGL (Y+) variant, which is what Unity expects.
All assets are CC0 (public domain). See LICENSES.md.
